capabilities.title: Character CRUD
capabilities.notes: Kernel-owned ops with component tests; desktop/headless/android hosts Integrated/Implemented. Этап 2.10 (golden-flow UI cutover, шаг 2): the library CRUD hooks (useCharacters/useCharacter/useCreateCharacter/useUpdateCharacter/useDeleteCharacter) route through the facade `apps/web/src/api/wireBridge.ts` in kernel mode — wire ops + wire→UI translation with honest defaults (avatar URL, card fields personality/scenario/firstMessage etc. are not modelled by the wire contract yet and surface CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE via UnsupportedError when actually requested, never a silent downgrade); the browser/sidecar mode keeps the legacy /api/v2 routes unchanged. Kernel list is newest-first (cursor/limit only): search (q), tag filter and non-default sorts are honest UnsupportedError in kernel mode (Этап 4).

capabilities.title: Chat CRUD
capabilities.notes: Kernel-owned ops with component tests (round-trip, CHARACTER/CHAT_NOT_FOUND, title rename, message-count subquery, cascade delete). Этап 2.10 (шаг 2): chat CRUD hooks (useChats/useRecentChats/useChat/useCreateChat/useUpdateChat/useDeleteChat/useContinueCharacterChat) route through the facade in kernel mode. Honest boundaries: kernel chats are created EMPTY (greeting insertion and the reuseUnstarted guard are legacy pipeline features — the continue hook reproduces the guard client-side), delete is permanent (cascade; legacy soft-delete/trash is Этап 4), wire chat update is title-only (persona/background/summary/branch mutation → UnsupportedError), personaId/greetingIndex inputs → UnsupportedError, kernel ordering is by created_at DESC (manual/recent-updated ordering — Этап 4). Browser/sidecar mode keeps the legacy routes.

capabilities.title: Message CRUD
capabilities.notes: Kernel-owned ops with component tests (atomic sequence allocation per chat, role/content edit, scoped MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND, chat-scoped delete). Этап 2.10: UI edit/delete run through the facade (`backend.chats.updateMessage/delMessage` — wire on the kernel, legacy-route bridge on the sidecar; the legacy `expectedRevision` CAS is not part of the wire contract, kernel updates are last-write-wins); message create runs over the wire in the kernel-mode send flow; the message-list hook (useMessages) now loads newest-first over the wire `order: 'desc'` pages in kernel mode (additive wire field, Этап 2.10) with wire→UI translation (branchId defaults to the chat id — the kernel keeps one linear sequence per chat; variants/revisions/checkpoints/meta are not modelled yet and render as neutral defaults). branchId input on the kernel → UnsupportedError (branches — Этап 4).

capabilities.title: Generation workflow (stream, cancel, retry, keep, discard)
capabilities.notes: Durable run/event model in kernel; run/step + tool protocol is M2 (GEN-RUN 10A/10B). Desktop host Integrated: the packaged golden slice (NEOTA_DESKTOP_SMOKE=1, Этап 2.9) drives character → chat → message → generation.start → durable save over the real Tauri host path (shell → KernelHost envelope → kernel → SQLite). Этап 2.10: the UI send flow streams over the Product Wire in kernel mode (`chats.messages.create` + `generation.start` via LocalBackend, deltas/completed/failed mapped onto the streaming handler); the browser/sidecar path keeps the legacy SSE route; regeneration and frontend prompt interceptors remain legacy-only and surface an honest UnsupportedError on the kernel (kernel prompt pipeline owns the prompt; interceptors deferred to the plugin cutover).

capabilities.title: Provider catalog read

capabilities.title: Provider configuration (secrets out of the DB)
capabilities.notes: Kernel-owned ops with component tests (ТЗ §9.4, Этап 2.4): provider_configs rows hold non-secret config_json plus an opaque secret_ref; the API key is stored through the kernel's SecretStore seam (Kernel::set_secret_store) and never reaches the DB, the wire DTO, backups or diagnostics — get/list report only hasApiKey. Without a wired store, set with apiKey fails SECRET_UNAVAILABLE (fail-closed); delete revokes the stored secret. Hosts wire real SecretStore backends in M3 (OS vault / Keystore / portable).

capabilities.title: OpenAI-compatible production provider
capabilities.notes: Adapter crate (ТЗ §9.3, Этап 2.5) with 14 unit + 4 kernel integration tests: chat-completions streaming over a minimal blocking HTTP/1.1 client with rustls TLS (OS trust store), bounded SSE reads (SEC-04), normalized errors. API key resolved at execution time from the config's secret_ref through the SecretResolver seam (Kernel::set_secret_resolver) and passed via ProviderRequest::api_key — only in the Authorization header, never in body/DB/logs; missing resolver fails closed. Registration via the new Kernel::register_provider seam; config instance selection in the run model. Этап 2.7: serializes declared tools (function schema) and the resumed-turn tool context (assistant tool_calls + tool-role result), accumulates SSE tool_calls deltas into normalized ProviderEvent::ToolCall. Этап 2.8: kernel integration test drives the full tool round trip over the real SSE path — turn 1 streams a normalized tool call, the kernel validates and durably waits, generation.tool.result resumes turn 2 with the tool context, the run completes with exactly one assistant message; both HTTP bodies are asserted (tools serialization + resumed tool_call_id).

capabilities.title: Durable run/step journal + tool-call loop (waiting_for_tool)
capabilities.notes: Этап 2.7 (ТЗ §8.3): the kernel journals every generation step in generation_steps (migration 6: ALTER TABLE generation_runs ADD COLUMN pending_tool_call_json + generation_steps table, no rebuild) and streams generation.step events (provider_turn/tool_call/tool_result/final_commit). A provider turn emitting a tool call is validated against the declarative tool registry (capability + minimal JSON-Schema argument check) and durably transitions the run to waiting_for_tool — a DERIVED wire status from the pending marker (DB status stays streaming; the v3 CHECK is untouched). The kernel NEVER executes tools: the host performs the effect and submits generation.tool.result, which journals the tool_result step, clears the marker and resumes the provider turn with the assistant tool_calls + tool-role messages. Stable terminal codes: TOOL_NOT_FOUND / TOOL_ARGS_INVALID / TOOL_LOOP_LIMIT (8 calls max) / TOOL_RESULT_STALE (non-idempotent submission). Crash-at-wait: fresh lease survives a reopen and the result still resumes; expired lease → interrupted (retry-safe). Этап 2.8: waiting-run cancel/retry — generation.cancel finalizes cancelled itself for a waiting run (no live executor) and every terminal writer clears the pending marker; retry from a cancelled waiting run starts attempt 2; retry on a still-waiting run is GENERATION_RUN_STATE_CONFLICT. Tools register via Kernel::register_tool; generation.tools.list (app.read) serves the registry. Tests: 7 tools.rs unit + 2 fake unit + 2 adapter + 10 tool_loop.rs kernel integration + 1 providers_openai tool round trip + 1 storage migration test. Этап 2.9: desktop host Integrated — the packaged golden slice registers a tool and completes a full waiting_for_tool → tool.result round trip over the real Tauri host path (NEOTA_DESKTOP_SMOKE=1); the host seam KernelHost::register_tool was added, and both Tauri-local and remote-http stream pollers now close the consumer stream when a run durably waits (previously an unbounded poll loop). Honest boundary: JSON-Schema validation covers a documented subset (object/required/additionalProperties + scalar/array/object types); the full schema engine is a follow-up. Этап 2.10: the facade exposes `generation.tools.list` / `generation.tool.result` on every NeoBackend implementation (LocalBackend over the wire; LegacyBackend honest UnsupportedError — no legacy route; RemoteBackend over the SDK); the UI has no tool surface yet — tool UX (step rendering, waiting_for_tool state, result submission) is Этап 4.

capabilities.title: Prompt pipeline: durable PromptPlan (history/character/lorebook/token budget)
capabilities.notes: Kernel pipeline (ТЗ §9.1–§9.2, Этап 2.6): every generation run builds an immutable PromptPlan (character/persona system blocks from the card incl. ext_json.personality, lorebook keyword activation with constant/selective rules, last 128 non-tool history messages, heuristic-v1 approximate token budget with response-room reservation and oldest-unpinned truncation recording every excluded message id), stores it in prompt_plans (schema migration 5) and passes the instruct-neutral message array to adapters via ProviderRequest.messages — the OpenAI adapter serializes it verbatim. generation.prompt.plan (app.read) serves the stored plan; stable PROMPT_PLAN_FAILED / PROMPT_PLAN_NOT_FOUND. Tests: 5 unit + 2 kernel integration + 1 adapter. Honest boundaries: approximate tokenizer (model-specific registry pending), instruct template rendering deferred, lorebook character-scoping awaits the lorebook cutover.

capabilities.title: Lorebook CRUD
capabilities.notes: M4 slice 1 (Этап 4.1): full lorebook CRUD in the kernel through Product Wire — lorebooks.get/create/update/delete joined the existing lorebooks.list; entries travel as wire.lorebook.entry.input objects (keys/secondaryKeys/content/enabled/constant/selective) that the prompt pipeline already activates (constant always, keyword case-insensitive substring, selective primary+secondary), stored into entries_json with entryCount derived via json_array_length. Stable product errors: LOREBOOK_NOT_FOUND with lorebookId param; strict unknown-field rejection. Tested at three levels: 2 kernel integration tests (full create→get→update→delete round trip + NOT_FOUND/CONTRACT_VIOLATION paths), wire corpus (5 new positive + 6 new negative fixtures), and a remote-http host-parity test (lorebook_crud_over_http, error copied verbatim into the envelope). Honest boundary: UI surface and legacy /api/v2/lorebooks route removal remain Этап 4; character↔lorebook scoping (characterId link) is not yet modeled in the kernel schema.

capabilities.title: Persona CRUD

The single-default invariant matches the legacy PersonaRepository: create/update with isDefault clears the previous default in the same transaction. Wire DTO wire.persona.dto carries name/description/avatar/isDefault/createdAt/updatedAt (description/avatar optional); stable PERSONA_NOT_FOUND with personaId param. Tested at three levels: 2 kernel integration tests (round trip incl. default demotion + NOT_FOUND/contract paths), wire corpus (4 positive + 5 negative fixtures), and a remote-http host-parity test (persona_crud_over_http). Honest boundary: chat.persona_id linkage and prompt {{user}} injection from the persona table are not wired yet (the prompt pipeline still reads the card ext_json.personality persona block); legacy /api/v2/personas route removal and the UI surface remain Этап 4 follow-ups.

capabilities.notes: SEC-02: Implemented in M1 Wave 1 — the legacy export is now a logical allowlist archive (format v2: manifest.json with exported tables/counts, exclusions and redactions, one JSONL per allowlisted table, no DB snapshot; apps/server/src/lib/profileExport.ts). capabilities.title: Plugin network broker (SSRF policy + bounded streaming)
capabilities.notes: SEC-03/SEC-04 (M1 Wave 1): plugin network.http.fetch and socket destinations pass the §29.1 SSRF scope policy — every DNS answer checked, bracketed IPv6 and IPv4-mapped literals normalized, per-hop redirect re-checks, connect to the policy-approved IP with the hostname only in Host/SNI and post-connect remoteAddress verification; response bodies are capped while streaming and the connection is destroyed on exceed (apps/plugin-runtime/src/host). WebSocket post-connect verification is a documented follow-up.

capabilities.title: Plugin package trust (signature/digest verification)
capabilities.notes: SEC-05 (M1 Wave 1): publisher Ed25519 signature + per-file sha256 digest verification before consent/install (format neotavern.package-signature.v1, apps/server/src/lib/packageTrust.ts); trust states built-in / verified-publisher / locally-trusted / unsigned-untrusted recorded in the plugin registry (migration 0023) and surfaced as InstalledPlugin.trust; NEOTA_PLUGIN_PUBLISHER_KEYS keyring + NEOTA_PLUGIN_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE policy; unsigned packages enabled via consent become locally-trusted; ZIP/tar.gz reject duplicate normalized paths, symlinks, traversal, encrypted entries and bounded zip bombs.

capabilities.title: Restore maintenance lock (global maintenance mode)
capabilities.notes: M1 Wave 1 (ТЗ §10.4): restore runs exclusively under a global maintenance lock (apps/server/src/lib/maintenance.ts) — while held, new product mutations are rejected with the stable MAINTENANCE_MODE error (503), plugin activation is blocked and no second restore can enter; read-only requests and backup/diagnostics tooling keep working; the lock is released on every exit path (success and failure). Full stop-the-world (suspending in-flight generations, staged data-root activation) is the M3 DATA-ACTIVATE slice.

capabilities.title: SecretStore (secrets out of the main DB, portable secrets.enc)
capabilities.notes: SEC-01 (M1 Wave 1): new SecretStore port package (packages/secret-store) with three explicit backends — portable encrypted secrets.enc (AES-256-GCM, versioned scrypt KDF, authenticated header, atomic writes, fresh nonce per write, machine-independent key derivation, lock/re-encrypt), session-only memory (no plaintext fallback) and a read-only env provider for headless (NEOTA_SECRET_*). Provider and plugin secrets no longer live in app.db: migration 0024 adds value_ref columns and the DB stores only opaque references (portable:/session:/env:), resolved at runtime via ctx.secrets (apps/server/src/lib/secretStore.ts, migration 0024). Pre-migration plaintext rows are imported at bootstrap (idempotent). A reference whose backend cannot produce the value surfaces SECRET_UNAVAILABLE_ON_THIS_DEVICE (422) — never a plaintext fallback; backups and profile exports contain no secrets. Kernel-plane port delivered (crates/secret-store, ADR-0040): canonical portable v2 format with Argon2id (m=64 MiB/t=3/p=1) + AES-256-GCM, authenticated header, staged re-encryption, cross-machine portability tests (15 tests). OS-vault / Android Keystore adapters and the full portable UX (passphrase prompt, auto-lock UI) remain M3.

capabilities.title: Legacy compatibility authority boundary (ARC-11)
capabilities.notes: M1 Wave 1 (ТЗ §14.2, ADR-0039): per-legacy-API authority map shipped as packages/legacy-compat/COMPATIBILITY.md and enforced by apps/server/test/legacyAuthority.spec.ts — legacy Express routers are confined to /api/plugins/{id}/... (core /api/v2 routes are never shadowed), extension settings are namespaced per installed plugin with a 1 MiB bound, and the scoped plugin VFS is wired to <data-root>/plugins/{id}/data with ../ and backslash escapes rejected and files.plugin required (PLUGIN_PERMISSION_DENIED without the grant).

capabilities.title: Portable data / activation / restore
capabilities.notes: M3 (ADR-0041): versioned data roots (roots/root-<id>/ + active-root.json pointer), durable activation journal with prepared/validated/activation_pending/committed/rolled_back statuses, and the Windows restart-to-complete protocol (bounded transient retry, activation_pending after budget, resolve at open) implemented in neotavern_storage::activation with 21 integration tests; v1 flat layout still fully supported. The staged legacy→kernel migration in the application flow (neotavern_storage::migration: lease-locked preflight incl. disk space, verified pre-migration-* safety copy, convert into a staging versioned root, FK/current-revision validation, report, journaled commit with bounded retry, idempotent re-run, cancel-before-activation) is implemented with 19 integration tests. The migration corpus (ТЗ §17.4) covers: all released schema revisions 1..6 upgrade, future schema fails closed, corrupted DB detected, interrupted migration recovers, the REAL Drizzle layout maps completely (card fields personality/scenario/first_message/example_dialogues/system_prompt/post_history_instructions/creator/creator_notes survive into ext_json; character_tags/tags join merged into tags_json; unknown ext preserved; soft-deleted rows skipped and reported), a 1000x1000x3000 library converts with exact counts, unicode/RTL/20k-char values round-trip, and the Windows platform corpus holds a real handle without FILE_SHARE_DELETE: pointer switch exhausts the bounded retry budget, commit returns the stable recoverable ActivationPending, the next open resolves it (restart-to-complete). The CLI host flow (neotavern-cli --migrate-legacy, Этап 3 work 7-8) runs the offline converter with the kernel closed, then opens the kernel on the activated root — the canonical data-root switch is verified by product reads (13 CLI E2E tests incl. characters.get round-trip on the versioned root). Remaining Этап 3 slice: upgrade drills on packaged Windows/macOS/Linux artifacts. The upgrade drill (scripts/upgrade-drill.mjs, Этап 3 work 7) proves the cross-platform upgrade cycle on the real CLI artifact: a Drizzle-style fixture converts, characters.get returns the migrated character, the legacy database stays byte-identical (immutable source, ТЗ §10.3), re-running the migration is idempotent (one committed entry, one staging root), the pre-migration safety copy matches the source checksum, and the journal ends committed with the rollback pointer retained. PASS on Windows in this session; macOS/Linux runs gate the release branch in CI (Windows lock-contention/restart-to-complete stays covered by the Rust held-handle test).
